description: This source file implements functions and classes related to network interface management on Fuchsia, including conversion of IP addresses, verification and creation of interface properties, appending network interfaces to a list, checking if interfaces are publicly routable, and retrieving network lists.

classes.name: InterfaceProperties
classes.description: Represents network interface properties on Fuchsia, including verification, updating, appending network interfaces, and checking routability.

methods.name: FuchsiaIpAddressToIPAddress
methods.description: Converts a Fuchsia IP address to a generic IPAddress object.

methods.name: InterfaceProperties::VerifyAndCreate
methods.description: Verifies and creates an InterfaceProperties object from Fuchsia interface properties.

methods.name: InterfaceProperties::Update
methods.description: Updates the interface properties with new data.

methods.name: InterfaceProperties::AppendNetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Appends network interface details to a list.

methods.name: InterfaceProperties::IsPubliclyRoutable
methods.description: Checks if the interface is publicly routable.

methods.name: ConvertConnectionType
methods.description: Converts Fuchsia device class to network connection type.

methods.name: VerifyCompleteInterfaceProperties
methods.description: Verifies that interface properties are complete and valid.
